description: This file defines the EditView class for SuiteCRM, providing methods to process and display the edit view template for a module. It manages template variables, assigns module-specific data, and renders the view.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the preparation and rendering of an edit view template for a CRM module within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EditView object with specified module and template, and creates a new Sugar_Smarty instance.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Assigns various application, configuration, and module-specific variables to the Smarty template for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches and returns the HTML output of the assigned template using the Smarty engine.
